text_markup: If the "interface" flag appears before a paid ability's trigger cost, that ability is an Interface ability and is subject to the restrictions of icebreakers discussed in {ref:subsec_icebreakers}. Interface abilities do not have a special priority window type.
text_plain: If the "interface" flag appears before a paid ability's trigger cost, that ability is an Interface ability and is subject to the restrictions of icebreakers discussed in section 3.9.5. Interface abilities do not have a special priority window type.
